name: warnings2_v9
title: Plugin version 9 only (the owner copies the v9 nvf_capture.dll into the game's Data/NVSE/Plugins first; tools never write there). The key sessions of warnings2 with GetTrespassWarningLevel player (the moment of each warning, so the 15 s split), IsIdlePlaying on every actor, fight events, and screenshots while the tracked actor warns. Run each session alone (--only).
